instruction: Cinematic film still, medium shot. In a bright dance studio with large windows, two dancers pose back-to-back. On the left, the man in the blue t-shirt and red headband (R2) turns his body away while smiling back over his shoulder with raised fists. On the right, the woman in the light blue leotard (R1) also stands with her back to the camera, looking over her shoulder with a soft expression and her arm raised. Bright daylight from the windows behind them fills the room, creating a soft, airy atmosphere with a pastel color palette of blues and pinks.
